{{nihongo|'''Takefutsu Shrine'''|建布都神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Ichibachō Kagami|Q47393149|qid=Q47393149}}, {{ill|Awa, Tokushima|Q791587|qid=Q791587}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}. {{nihongo|'''Takefutsu Shrine'''|建布都神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

== History ==
[[File:Takehutsu shrine (Tomb), Ichiba-cho, Tokushima.jpg|thumb|right|Takefutsu Tumulus]]
The year of establishment is unknown. Until the {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}}, it was called Heiji Gongen or Heichi-shi, and was popularly known by the nickname "Ohēshi-san." After a dispute with {{ill|Hachiman shrine|lt=Hachiman Shrine|qid=Q11390939}} over identification as the Shikinaisha, the shrine was restored to its current name in the Meiji era. Within the shrine grounds, there is the Takefutsu Tumulus, a circular tumulus approximately 17 meters in diameter.

It is one of the candidate shrines (disputed identification) for Takefutsu Shrine listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}''. In {{ill|Donari-chō Kōri|ja|土成町郡|qid=Q28692234}}, Awa City, there is {{ill|Takefutsu Nishinomiya Shrine|Q48758357|qid=Q48758357}}.
